channel.title: Parallax
channel.description: Same event, different vantage points. Geopolitical news compared across Western, Eastern, Middle Eastern and Russian outlets.

item.title: Houthi projectiles strike a Saudi refinery in Jazan causing casualties and operational disruptions.
item.description: On November 27, 2026, a Houthi projectile struck a Saudi oil refinery in Jazan, causing at least one death, several injuries, and a temporary suspension of operations. While all sources confirm the physical damage and casualties, reporting differs in narrative scope. Middle Eastern outlets frame the strike as a significant escalation in a cycle of regional retaliation, whereas other reports focus more on the immediate tactical impact and local infrastructure damage.
